_comment: GENERATED FILE - do not edit by hand. Derived from the live FastMCP component registry; regenerate with `python scripts/generate_tool_inventory.py`.

tools.name: analysis_bounding_box
tools.summary: Get the overall extents of everything drawn.

tools.name: analysis_entity_stats
tools.summary: Count the drawing's objects, broken down by type and by layer.

tools.name: analysis_find_in_region
tools.summary: List everything that falls inside a rectangular window.

tools.name: analysis_layer_stats
tools.summary: Report how many entities, and which types, sit on each layer.

tools.name: analysis_list_properties
tools.summary: Dump every DXF property of one entity, like LIST.

tools.name: analysis_measure_area
tools.summary: Measure a polygon's area and perimeter from its vertices.

tools.name: analysis_measure_distance
tools.summary: Measure the gap between two points: distance, dx/dy and angle.

tools.name: analysis_measure_entity
tools.summary: Area and perimeter of an existing entity, by handle.

tools.name: analysis_select_by_layer
tools.summary: Grab the handles of everything sitting on one layer.

tools.name: analysis_select_by_type
tools.summary: Grab the handles of every entity of one type: all the circles, all the lines.

tools.name: block_create_from_entities
tools.summary: Turn existing entities into a reusable block definition.

tools.name: block_explode
tools.summary: Break a block reference apart into its component entities.

tools.name: block_find_references
tools.summary: Find every place a given block is inserted.

tools.name: block_get_attributes
tools.summary: Read the tag/value pairs off a block reference.

tools.name: block_insert
tools.summary: Place a block, filling in its attribute values as you go.

tools.name: block_list
tools.summary: List the block definitions the drawing already carries.

tools.name: block_set_attributes
tools.summary: Fill in a block reference's attributes, such as title-block fields.

tools.name: boundary_from_entities
tools.summary: Join named entities into one closed boundary polyline.

tools.name: boundary_trace
tools.summary: Trace the closed boundary around a point, like BOUNDARY.

tools.name: cad_batch
tools.summary: Run an ordered list of tool calls in one round trip, binding results between steps.

tools.name: construction_clear
tools.summary: Wipe the construction scaffolding off the drawing before finalize.

tools.name: construction_xline
tools.summary: Lay down an infinite guide line to build geometry against.

tools.name: datum_feature
tools.summary: Mark a datum on a feature: filled triangle plus the boxed datum letter.

tools.name: dimension_aligned
tools.summary: Dimension the true distance between two points, along a slope.

tools.name: dimension_angular
tools.summary: Dimension the included angle between two rays from a vertex.

tools.name: dimension_auto
tools.summary: Dimension a set of entities at once, as a chain, baseline or ordinate run.

tools.name: dimension_diameter
tools.summary: Call out a hole or shaft diameter, optionally to a fit such as H7.

tools.name: dimension_linear
tools.summary: Dimension a horizontal or vertical size, with an ISO 129 tolerance or ISO 286 fit.

tools.name: dimension_radius
tools.summary: Call out the radius of a circle or arc, optionally toleranced.

tools.name: drawing_apply_iso_layers
tools.summary: Set up a standard ISO layer set with the right colours and lineweights.

tools.name: drawing_audit
tools.summary: Scan the drawing for structural errors and repair what it finds.

tools.name: drawing_close
tools.summary: Close the drawing, saving first unless you say otherwise.

tools.name: drawing_critique
tools.summary: Review the drawing for drafting mistakes: must come back empty before finalize.

tools.name: drawing_deliver
tools.summary: Hand the drawing off: a hashed, validated bundle of files plus a manifest.

tools.name: drawing_export_dxf
tools.summary: Write a DXF interchange copy of the drawing.

tools.name: drawing_export_pdf
tools.summary: Plot the drawing, or one paper-space layout, to PDF.

tools.name: drawing_finalize
tools.summary: Finish the drawing: validate, critique, save, screenshot and score it.

tools.name: drawing_info
tools.summary: Read the current drawing's name, path, extents and object counts.

tools.name: drawing_new
tools.summary: Start a blank drawing, pre-seeded with the standard engineering layers.

tools.name: drawing_open
tools.summary: Load an existing DXF from disk (DWG only on the live AutoCAD backend).

tools.name: drawing_plan
tools.summary: Commit sheet size, scale, layer set and dimension style before any geometry.

tools.name: drawing_preflight
tools.summary: Check the brief before you draw: units, part type, tolerances, missing inputs.

tools.name: drawing_purge
tools.summary: Strip unused layers, blocks, linetypes and styles out of the file.

tools.name: drawing_redo
tools.summary: Reapply the operation you just undid.

tools.name: drawing_refine
tools.summary: Auto-repair what the critique found, then re-check, up to three rounds.

tools.name: drawing_save
tools.summary: Write the drawing back to its file, or to a path you give.

tools.name: drawing_save_as
tools.summary: Save a copy under a new name; the extension picks DXF, DWG or DWT.

tools.name: drawing_settings
tools.summary: Read or change drawing units, precision, linetype and dimension scale by name.

tools.name: drawing_undo
tools.summary: Step back one operation.

tools.name: entity_array_polar
tools.summary: Repeat an entity around a centre: a bolt circle or radial pattern.

tools.name: entity_array_rectangular
tools.summary: Repeat an entity in a grid of rows and columns.

tools.name: entity_batch_create
tools.summary: Draw many entities in one call instead of one round trip each.

tools.name: entity_batch_modify
tools.summary: Move, rotate, scale, restyle or delete many entities in one call.

tools.name: entity_chamfer
tools.summary: Bevel a corner between two lines by two setback distances.

tools.name: entity_change_space
tools.summary: Move entities between model space and a sheet through a viewport.

tools.name: entity_copy
tools.summary: Duplicate an entity and offset the copy.

tools.name: entity_create_arc
tools.summary: Draw a circular arc from a centre, a radius and two angles.

tools.name: entity_create_block_ref
tools.summary: Drop an instance of an existing block definition into the drawing.

tools.name: entity_create_circle
tools.summary: Draw a circle: a hole, a bore, a pitch circle.

tools.name: entity_create_ellipse
tools.summary: Draw an ellipse from its centre, major axis vector and axis ratio.

tools.name: entity_create_hatch
tools.summary: Fill a closed boundary with a section pattern such as ANSI31 or SOLID.

tools.name: entity_create_line
tools.summary: Draw a straight line between two points.

tools.name: entity_create_mtext
tools.summary: Place a wrapped paragraph note in a text box of a given width.

tools.name: entity_create_point
tools.summary: Place a point marker (node) at a coordinate.

tools.name: entity_create_polyline
tools.summary: Draw a connected outline or closed profile through a list of points.

tools.name: entity_create_rectangle
tools.summary: Draw a closed rectangle from two opposite corners.

tools.name: entity_create_revcloud
tools.summary: Draw a revision cloud around an area.

tools.name: entity_create_spline
tools.summary: Draw a smooth NURBS curve through fit points.

tools.name: entity_create_table
tools.summary: Place a parts list, BOM or schedule as a table with headers and rows.

tools.name: entity_create_text
tools.summary: Place a single-line text label.

tools.name: entity_create_wipeout
tools.summary: Mask whatever is behind a closed polygon on the sheet.

tools.name: entity_delete
tools.summary: Erase one entity by handle.

tools.name: entity_delete_many
tools.summary: Erase a whole list of entities in one call.

tools.name: entity_edit_geometry
tools.summary: Change a circle's radius, a line's endpoints or an arc's angles in place.

tools.name: entity_edit_text
tools.summary: Reword a label, or change its height or rotation, keeping its handle.

tools.name: entity_extend
tools.summary: Lengthen a line until it meets a boundary line.

tools.name: entity_fillet
tools.summary: Round a corner between two lines with a tangent arc.

tools.name: entity_get
tools.summary: Inspect one entity by handle: type, layer, colour and geometry.

tools.name: entity_list
tools.summary: Browse the drawing's entities and their handles, filtered by type or layer.

tools.name: entity_mirror
tools.summary: Reflect an entity across a mirror line, keeping or dropping the original.

tools.name: entity_move
tools.summary: Shift an entity by a displacement vector.

tools.name: entity_offset
tools.summary: Make a parallel copy of a line, circle or polyline at a set distance.

tools.name: entity_rotate
tools.summary: Turn an entity about a base point by an angle in degrees.

tools.name: entity_scale
tools.summary: Resize an entity uniformly about a base point.

tools.name: entity_select_smart
tools.summary: Pick every entity matching a description: type, layer, colour, length, location.

tools.name: entity_set_properties
tools.summary: Change an entity's layer, colour, linetype, lineweight or visibility.

tools.name: entity_trim
tools.summary: Cut a line back to where another crosses it, keeping the side you point at.

tools.name: gd_frame
tools.summary: Draw an ISO 1101 feature control frame: symbol, tolerance zone and datums.

tools.name: gear_draw_helical_front_view
tools.summary: Draw a helical gear front view: true involute teeth, circles, bore and keyway.

tools.name: gear_draw_section_aa
tools.summary: Draw the hatched side cross-section A-A of a gear you already drew.

tools.name: gear_draw_spur_front_view
tools.summary: Draw a straight-tooth spur gear front view with true involute teeth.

tools.name: hatch_add_boundary
tools.summary: Add a boundary path to a hatch, arcs and ellipses included.

tools.name: hatch_edit
tools.summary: Change a hatch's pattern, scale, angle, colour or island style.

tools.name: hatch_set_gradient
tools.summary: Replace a hatch's fill with a two-colour gradient.

tools.name: keyway_draw_keyed_bore
tools.summary: Draw a bore with a DIN 6885 keyway, auto-sized from the bore diameter.

tools.name: keyway_draw_section
tools.summary: Draw the side cross-section of a keyed bore.

tools.name: layer_create
tools.summary: Add a layer with a colour, linetype and lineweight.

tools.name: layer_delete
tools.summary: Remove an empty layer from the drawing.

tools.name: layer_freeze
tools.summary: Freeze a layer so it stops drawing and regenerating.

tools.name: layer_hide
tools.summary: Turn a layer off so its entities stop showing.

tools.name: layer_isolate
tools.summary: Hide every layer except one, to work on it alone.

tools.name: layer_list
tools.summary: List every layer with its colour, linetype and visibility state.

tools.name: layer_lock
tools.summary: Lock a layer so its entities can be seen but not edited.

tools.name: layer_modify
tools.summary: Change an existing layer's colour, linetype or lineweight.

tools.name: layer_set_current
tools.summary: Choose the layer that new geometry lands on.

tools.name: layer_show
tools.summary: Turn a layer that was switched off back on.

tools.name: layer_thaw
tools.summary: Bring a frozen layer back into view.

tools.name: layer_unlock
tools.summary: Unlock a layer so its entities can be edited again.

tools.name: layout_copy
tools.summary: Duplicate a sheet with its page setup and geometry.

tools.name: layout_create
tools.summary: Add a new paper-space sheet tab to the drawing.

tools.name: layout_delete
tools.summary: Delete a sheet tab and everything drawn on it.

tools.name: layout_list
tools.summary: List the sheet tabs: Model plus every paper-space layout.

tools.name: layout_rename
tools.summary: Rename a sheet tab, keeping its geometry and handles.

tools.name: layout_set_current
tools.summary: Switch to a sheet tab, or back to model space.

tools.name: leader_create_mleader
tools.summary: Add a callout: an arrow with a note on the end.

tools.name: linetype_list
tools.summary: List the dash patterns currently loaded in the drawing.

tools.name: linetype_load
tools.summary: Load a linetype such as CENTER or HIDDEN, without the FILEDIA dialog trap.

tools.name: point_from_snap
tools.summary: Get an exact endpoint, midpoint, centre, quadrant or perpendicular foot.

tools.name: point_intersection
tools.summary: Find where two lines or circles cross, exactly.

tools.name: point_tangent
tools.summary: Find where a line from an outside point touches a circle.

tools.name: selection_filter
tools.summary: Select entities by layer, type, colour, linetype or minimum area.

tools.name: selection_get
tools.summary: Read what the user already picked in the AutoCAD viewport (COM backend).

tools.name: selection_polygon
tools.summary: Select entities inside or crossing an arbitrary polygon.

tools.name: selection_window
tools.summary: Select entities inside or crossing a rectangle.

tools.name: solid_boolean
tools.summary: Union, subtract or intersect two 3D solids; the tool solid is consumed.

tools.name: solid_box
tools.summary: Create a 3D solid box (live AutoCAD, opt-in via ENABLE_3D).

tools.name: solid_cylinder
tools.summary: Create a 3D solid cylinder or shaft (live AutoCAD, opt-in via ENABLE_3D).

tools.name: solid_extrude
tools.summary: Pull a closed profile up into a 3D solid (live AutoCAD, opt-in via ENABLE_3D).

tools.name: solid_revolve
tools.summary: Spin a closed profile around an axis into a 3D solid (opt-in via ENABLE_3D).

tools.name: system_about
tools.summary: See what this server can do: version, tool groups and active profile.

tools.name: system_capabilities
tools.summary: Ask the active backend which features it really supports.

tools.name: system_get_variable
tools.summary: Read one AutoCAD system variable, such as DIMSCALE or LTSCALE.

tools.name: system_run_command
tools.summary: Send a raw command string to the AutoCAD command line (COM only).

tools.name: system_run_lisp
tools.summary: Evaluate an AutoLISP expression inside AutoCAD (COM only).

tools.name: system_set_variable
tools.summary: Set one AutoCAD system variable by name.

tools.name: system_status
tools.summary: Check the connection: which engine is live and what document is open.

tools.name: template_apply_layers
tools.summary: Create a standard layer set: architectural, mechanical, electrical or piping.

tools.name: template_list
tools.summary: Show the available layer templates and the layers in each.

tools.name: text_find_replace
tools.summary: Find and replace text across the drawing.

tools.name: text_set_background
tools.summary: Put an opaque background box behind an MTEXT.

tools.name: titleblock_apply_iso_a3
tools.summary: Stamp an ISO 7200 title block and sheet frame onto an A3 drawing.

tools.name: transaction_begin
tools.summary: Open a rollback checkpoint before a risky edit.

tools.name: transaction_commit
tools.summary: Keep the changes and drop the checkpoint.

tools.name: transaction_rollback
tools.summary: Throw away every change made since transaction_begin.

tools.name: validation_check
tools.summary: Sanity-check the drawing for empty layers, zero-length lines and duplicates.

tools.name: view_screenshot
tools.summary: Capture a PNG picture of the drawing as it currently looks.

tools.name: view_zoom_and_screenshot
tools.summary: Fit the drawing on screen, then capture it: the quickest visual check.

tools.name: view_zoom_extents
tools.summary: Zoom out until every entity fits on screen.

tools.name: view_zoom_window
tools.summary: Zoom in on a rectangular region of the drawing.

tools.name: viewport_create
tools.summary: Put a scaled window onto model space on a sheet, at 1:1, 1:2 and so on.

tools.name: viewport_delete
tools.summary: Remove a viewport from a sheet.

tools.name: viewport_list
tools.summary: List the viewports on a sheet with their scales and locks.

tools.name: viewport_lock
tools.summary: Lock a viewport so its scale cannot be zoomed away.

tools.name: viewport_set_scale
tools.summary: Set a viewport's scale, e.g. 1:2 or 1:50.
